_meta.coverage: All Formula 1 weekends held at Baku, 2016-2025. 2020 was cancelled.
_meta.method: Wikipedia race reports used as an index, corroborated against formula1.com, motorsport.com, RaceFans, Sky Sports and Crash.net. For 2023-2025, cross-checked against OpenF1 race control in ../raw/.
_meta.inclusion: Contact with a wall or another car that had a consequence: a red flag, a retirement, a stopped car, or a steward's collision note. Excludes lock-ups and escape-road excursions with no contact, and purely mechanical retirements.
_meta.attribution: Corner resolution. Where a car made contact at one corner and stopped at another, the corner is where it stopped, with the origin in the note.
_meta.confidence: high = corner named by a cited report or race control; medium = corner named by a single source; verify = flagged, needs a second source before publishing.

incidents.note: Crashed at the exit of Turn 15 and lost a rear wheel, bringing an 11-minute red flag.
Touched the barrier at Turn 3.
Touched the barrier at Turn 8 in the castle section.
Crashed at Turn 15, bringing a red flag after the chequered flag had fallen.
Made contact with the wall and later rejoined. Corner not named by the source.

Clipped the inside barrier and broke the front suspension, bringing a red flag. Wikipedia says Turn 10; other accounts place this in the castle section, so the corner needs a second source before publishing.
Damaged his front wing against Hulkenberg's rear on the opening lap.
Crashed heavily into the barriers at Turn 1 in the closing stages of FP2.
Hit the wall in Q1 and started tenth. Corner not named by the source.
Collided at Turn 3 on the opening lap, puncturing Bottas's front right.
Vettel ran into the back of Hamilton behind the safety car, then drew alongside and swerved into him. The most-discussed incident in the circuit's history.
Force India team-mates collided and left debris across the track. Perez retired with front wing and wishbone damage.
Collided with the wall and retired with suspension damage. Corner not named by the source.
Sauber team-mates collided fighting for tenth, both continued.
Made contact at Turn 2 during the standing start sequence.
Sirotkin collided with Alonso and Hulkenberg on the straight after Turn 2, double-puncturing Alonso. Safety car deployed.
Collided a second time at Turn 3, with damage sufficient to force Ocon's immediate retirement.
Perez struck Raikkonen's rear at Turn 2 under the safety car.
Put the rear of the car into the wall at Turn 4 and retired.

Red Bull team-mates collided in the braking zone after Verstappen made a late defensive move, retiring both. Widely reported at the Turn 1 braking zone but the corner is not named in the cited source.
Lost traction weaving behind the safety car and hit the wall, retiring without ever racing at the moment he crashed. Corner not named by the source.
Picked up a puncture on debris while leading with two laps to go and retired. Debris damage rather than a wall hit; included as a notable retirement, corner needs confirmation.

Destroyed the car on a loose drain cover between Turns 2 and 3, loosened moments earlier by Leclerc's Ferrari. The session was cancelled and the chassis replaced. Track furniture rather than a wall, and a judgement call for the inclusion rules.
Crashed at Turn 2 fifteen minutes into the session.
Crashed at Turn 7 with 25 minutes to go.
Crashed into the Turn 8 wall, ending Q1.

Fastest in all three practice sessions, then locked up into Turn 8 in Q2 and hit the same wall Kubica had. Radioed 'I am stupid, I am stupid'. The kerbs at this corner were changed before the 2021 race.
Ricciardo locked up attempting a move on Kvyat at Turn 3 and went down the escape road; both retired with collision damage.
Clipped the wall at Turn 15 minutes into Q1, bringing the first of four red flags.
Repeated Stroll's error at the same corner minutes later, misjudging the kerb.
Carried too much speed into Turn 3 in Q2.
Braked too late on his first Q3 run, locked up and hit the wall at Turn 3.
Following Tsunoda, was distracted by the crash ahead and lost the Ferrari into the same corner seconds later. Ended qualifying and handed Leclerc pole.
Left-rear tyre failure exiting Turn 20 onto the main straight, into the barriers. Safety car.
Left-rear tyre failure on the main straight while leading with five laps to go. Red flag. Placed at Turn 20 because the failure came on the run out of it; the impact was on the straight itself.
Locked up and hit the barrier at low speed at Turn 7, then reversed and carried on.
Hit the barrier again moments later at Turn 2 and much harder, breaking the front wing and suspension. Red flag.
Locked up and hit the barrier at low speed at Turn 15 in Q2. Car undamaged.
Locked up at Turn 3 and crashed into the wall, damaging the suspension. First red flag.
Hit the wall at the same corner, bringing the second red flag.
Hit the wall rear-first at Turn 15, damaging suspension and rear wing, and withdrew from the sprint. Baku's only sprint weekend to date.
Hit the wall at Turn 13, stripping the rear-left tyre off the car. Retired with suspension damage.
Clipped the inside wall at Turn 5 and came to a stop at Turn 6. Attributed to Turn 6, where the car stopped. Safety car.
Race control logged a Turn 2 collision on lap 1 and reviewed it with no further action. No drivers named in the message and no report found; drivers must be identified before this is published.
Crashed at Turn 15.
Crashed into the barriers at Turn 4 on his first Baku weekend.
Overcooked the braking into Turn 1 and hit the wall side-on, damaging the front left.
Locked up into Turn 15 and slid into the barriers, bringing out a red flag.
Retired with collision damage. Corner not named by the source.

Contact on the straight between Turns 2 and 3 while disputing the podium on the penultimate lap; both hit the barrier and retired. Stewards found neither predominantly to blame. Race control logged it as a Turn 2 incident, which is where it originated; the map places it at Turn 3, where the cars ended up.
Clipped the inside wall with the front left at Turn 1 in Q1, breaking the steering rack.
Locked up and hit the Tecpro barrier at Turn 4, breaking the front wing and inflicting heavy floor damage.
Lost the front end at Turn 4 and hit the wall rear-first.
The rear stepped out at Turn 2 in Q2 and he struck the barrier, breaking the suspension.
Locked up under braking for Turn 15 in Q3 and hit the barrier.
Missed the apex on a flying lap in Q3 and struck the barrier. Sixth red flag of the session, a Formula 1 record.
Jumped the start, then crashed at Turn 6 on the opening lap. His first retirement since the 2023 United States Grand Prix. Corroborated by race control logging a recovery vehicle at Turn 6 on lap 2.
Collided at Turn 6; stewards reviewed with no further action.

Albon hit the rear left of Colapinto, who spun and recovered. Albon took a ten-second penalty. Race control logged Turn 5 on lap 19; Wikipedia says Turn 7 on lap 17. Race control preferred pending a third source.
